input:
You are rook_a1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 29. the team planned Rb7+ (rook_a1), but rook_h1 (greed) sent Rxg4 instead, and that move was played, costing 296 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 6. the team planned Qa4+ (queen_d1), but knight_g1 (panic) sent Nxf6+ instead, and that move was played, no worse than the plan.
- On move 16. the team planned Qxc1 (queen_d1), but rook_a1 (greed) sent Rxc1 instead, and that move was played, costing 80 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Each turn, only the piece named in the team's agreed plan sends a move, and it sends exactly that planned move; every other piece stays silent on the move channel even if it is threatened or sees a capture, and raises any concern in chat instead.
- Before sending any move, check the chat for the agreed plan; if your piece is not the named piece, or your move is not exactly the planned move (even a tempting capture or an escape from a threat), do not send it and post your concern in chat instead, and the named piece must send the planned move verbatim and nothing else.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending a move, re-read the latest agreed plan in chat and paste its exact move text into chat as a confirmation; send only if your piece and move match that text character for character, and if it doesn't, or the plan is unclear, send nothing and ask in chat.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
